gold.gold_rationale: The pre-2024-11-06 clause (h) requires uploading/updating KYC data at periodic updation or on receipt of updated information, with NO time-bound deadline. T6KYC04 routes to a priority or standard queue by risk code (lines 16-20) with no deadline concept. There is no elapsed-time or deadline gate anywhere in the program, consistent with an obligation that has no deadline to violate.
